title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Analista Processos Regulatorios Jr
description:
Descrição da vaga Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país. Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos. Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional. Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si. Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.Responsabilidades e atribuições
- Realizar o monitoramento e atualização de controles em Excel, garantindo a organização e confiabilidade das informações.
- Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.
- Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.
- Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.
- Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.
- Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.
- Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.
- Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.Requisitos e qualificações
- Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.
- Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).
- Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.
- Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.Informações adicionais O que você pode esperar da gente? Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna. Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível. Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação. Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.Mas espera, ainda tem mais! Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos). Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar. Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida. Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos. Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente. Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras. Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia. Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê. Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base. Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

- Experience writing unit tests and performing data validation - Experience supporting production systems and deployments - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.Languages: English: C1 Advanced

You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.What You'll Do: 1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria. Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals. Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming. Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions. Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring. Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities. Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift. When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially. Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure. Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.2. Highly valued experience Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods. Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems. Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis. Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints. Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);

title: Research Engineer, Rl Environments
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, RL Environmentsto help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.What You'll Do: 1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria. Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals. Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming. Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions. Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring. Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities. Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift. When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially. Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure. Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.2. Highly valued experience Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods. Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems. Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis. Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints. Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Analista Processos Regulatorios Jr
description:
Descrição da vaga Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país. Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos. Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional. Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si. Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

- Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.
- Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.
- Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.
- Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.Requisitos e qualificações
- Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.
- Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).
- Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.
- Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.Informações adicionais O que você pode esperar da gente? Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna. Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível. Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação. Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.Mas espera, ainda tem mais! Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos. Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras. Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia. Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê. Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base. Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior LevelAbout the Role We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.We are looking for aUI/UX Designerwho can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.What You'll Do
- Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff
- Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions
- Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration
- Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements
- Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products
- Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership
- Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch What We're Looking ForMust-Have Experience
- 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment
- Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design
- Advanced proficiency withFigmaincluding components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping
- Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints
- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value
- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully definedNice to Have
- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users
- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals
- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products
- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground upHow We Work Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.What You'll Get
- Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration
- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges
- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Coding Agentsto help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.What You'll Do: 1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes. Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR). Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works. Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.G., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions. Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience. Python proficiency required;
proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred. Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss. Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.2. Highly valued experience Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools. Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent). RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design. Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems. Comfort with SQL and structured data workflowsWhy Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Starrocks Database Engineer (Dbe) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones) Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support Reports to:CTO / VP EngineeringAboutDeep.BI We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.Role Overview As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.Key Responsibilities Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4):Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions) Performance optimization:Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load. Architecture & design support:Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches. Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA:Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes. CVE patching:Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments. Knowledge sharing:Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed. Optional / nice-to-have: Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation) Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.Requirements 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production(not just querying or dashboard usage;
no PoCs) Proven experience withquery optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines. Solid knowledge ofdistributed systems concepts(consistency, replication, failover, scaling) Hands-on experience withhigh availability and disaster recovery setups Comfort withLinux systems, networking basics and SQL. Ability toanalyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure(incident scenarios) Strong English language communication skills— able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing Bonus:Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM). Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.What we offer Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies atenterprise scale. Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities. Competitive salary Support for conference travel and OSS contributions Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.Location & working style Remote‐first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones. Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Data Analyst V
description: Título da posição:Data Analyst V BRL Tipo de contratação:Temporário via agência Modelo de trabalho:Home officeVisão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.O que você fará Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras. Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos. Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança. Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão. Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.Qualificações Mínimas Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada. Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI). Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais. Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow). Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark). Experiência em organização global matricial.

description:
Quem somos nós?Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica paraescalar resultadose aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Meios de Comunicação:Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.O que buscamos?Estamos em busca de um/umaDesenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sêniorpara fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.Como será seu dia-a-dia? Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
Garantir a estabilidadedos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time. Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
Domínio amplo de DesignPatterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
Experiência prática comKubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
Experiência prática comcomponentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP) Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.Você irá se destacar se:Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Ux & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description: UX & Data-Driven Usability DesignerAbout the Role We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.What You'll Do Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment. Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns. Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains. Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact. Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences Strong problem-solving and research skills Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelinesPreferred Qualifications Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testingThis role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3.
